new_value: All four listed sites addressed (commit b82156623a + merge dfaaa7668c which brought in i72x.4's node.rs work): (1) lichen-link trust.rs verify_ygg_iid_binding + its 3 binding_invariant tests DELETED — the addr[8:16]==IID contract is void for upstream AddrForKey addresses; the tests pinned quarantined native-profile literals and the corpus consumers in Python/C (gcp3_trust_models.json) keep their own pins (i72x.6 owns corpus regen). (2) routing/util.rs dio_dis_destination_is_allowed: the fe80-destination IID is now compared against the node's LINK-LOCAL CONTROL address (local_control_addr = canonical_link_local) instead of local_rpl_addr, whose low 64 bits are AddrForKey pubkey bits post-migration; receive.rs 3 call sites updated. This RESTORES pre-migration gate semantics — post-i72x.2 the unicast branch matched nothing. (3) neighbor.rs remove_with_iid audited: VALID, neighbors are keyed by link-local DIO/DIS source addresses (this very gate requires canonical LL sources), so addr[8..]==signer_iid holds; no change. (4) dodag.rs:1655 successor = provisioning.rs canonical_link_local: audited VALID (LL construction; IID derivation unchanged per settled decision); no change. VERIFY: failure sets byte-identical before/after (22 unique panics: the SOS shared_vectors failure owned by oun2/rm2a mid-landing, and the DAO/authorization/rpl_stack clusters owned by ywec — e.g. multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received rejects BELOW the destination gate in the secure path, no PROBE output, so not this gate) — zero regressions from this slice; 26 binaries green incl. all of lichen-link minus the SOS vector; cargo check -p lichen-gateway -p lichen-cli clean. REVIEW: 3 delegate attempts (kimi-k3) hit exploration-timeouts without verdicts (same pattern worker8 recorded); per loop fallback, self-reviewed all three passes — correctness (gate semantics = pre-migration intent, LL-guard makes control/routable address spaces unambiguous), security (input-validation gate not weakened; removed helper had zero production callers), edge cases (control addr always provisioned at construction; multicast branch unchanged; remove_with_iid/canonical_link_local audited valid).
